messages.subject: Color MSA annotation by clade
parts:
Hi all,

Sorry but I have another question. 

I plotted a MSA annotation next to my phylogenetic tree but I would like to change the colors of the MSA so that it is colored by clade instead of nucleotide bases. Is there any function to do so?

I saw a similar figure in a paper which uses the same package to do it, but I couldn't figure out how. I attached my figure and the reference figure for viewing. 

I tried to adjust the color parameters in msaplot but I don't really understand how it works as there is not much explanation in the documentation. 

Could you please provide more explanation on the color parameter in msaplot and how I can make the figure similar to the one from the paper?

Thank you very much.
